tickets.title: Prepare Retirement Income Plan Checklist
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before presenting the retirement income plan for Selena Thimblefern:

- Confirm desired retirement timing (preferred age 62, open to part-time consulting) and any phased-work assumptions.
- Verify recurring spending needs (about $11,300 per month regular household spending plus $3,950 mortgage, $510 auto loan, irregular tuition and home repair costs), irregular expenses, and emergency reserve target ($72,000).
- Review Social Security claiming assumptions (estimated $3,050 per month at full retirement age in current dollars) and pension options; Selena has no pension.
- Identify taxable (about $542,000 at Velvet Acorn Custody), tax-deferred (401(k) about $710,000, rollover IRA about $156,000), and Roth (Roth IRA about $94,000) account balances available for withdrawals.
- Estimate sustainable withdrawal range under base, cautious, and stress scenarios, reflecting Nico's Tin Sparrow University enrollment, Lila's Moonbadger Preparatory costs, and expected use of taxable assets.
- Check required minimum distribution timing and tax bracket considerations.
- Coordinate investment allocation with near-term cash flow needs, including the Cloudberry Kite Biotech concentrated position and 529 distributions.
- Identify healthcare, Medicare, long-term care (60% long-term disability coverage up to plan cap), and insurance considerations.
- Document recommended income sources for the next planning period.
- List open items, assumptions, and follow-up decisions for the client.
tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is to refresh the retirement projection by 2026-06-19.
